newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HUVITUSFOND OPERATING INCOME AT 10.5 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: HUVITUSFOND OPERATING INCOME AT 10.5 MLN EEK.

text.p: Huvitusfond said on Wednesday that its April operating income was 10.5 million kroons compared to March's 14.5 million kroons.

Huvitusfond, which was established as a way of trading privatisation securities issued as compensation for unreturned nationalised property, said in a statement that its operating income for the first four months of 1997 was 52.4 million kroons.
The fund's balance sheet volume in April was 1.3 billion kroons, which was an increase of nine percent compared to March and a increase of 22.6 million kroons since the beginning of the year.
